# Hygeia Power Wash Solutions

> Commercial pressure washing, curbside trash bin sanitizing, and 100% Cal/EPA vacuum wastewater recovery across Silicon Valley and the San Francisco Peninsula.

## Organization
- Legal Entity: Montero Enterprises Inc. dba Hygeia
- Operating Experience: 35+ years serving Northern California commercial facilities
- California DVBE Certification: #2054658
- Department of Industrial Relations (DIR) Registered
- Environmental Compliance: 100% Cal/EPA Vacuum Wastewater Reclaim (Zero runoff to storm drains)
- Operations Center: 1105 Benton St., Santa Clara, CA 95050
- 24/7 Phone Dispatch: (650) 933-3823
- Email: aloha@hygeiaservices.com
- Main Website: https://hygeiapowerwash.com/ (Staging: https://pws.2.25.90.226.sslip.io/)

## Core Services
- Commercial Pressure Washing: High-pressure hot water (200°F) concrete cleaning, building facade washing, parking structures, and loading docks.
- Curbside Trash Can Cleaning: Automated 360-degree high-pressure sanitizing truck, 200°F water, hospital-grade eco-friendly deodorizer. Subscription plans starting at $35/mo.
- Dumpster Pad Degreasing: Commercial dumpster enclosure degreasing with 100% wastewater recovery to prevent stormwater fines and rodent infestation.
- EPA Wastewater Recovery: Specialized multi-stage filtration and vacuum recovery ensuring compliance with California Clean Water regulations.
- Emergency Commercial Dispatch: 24/7 rapid dispatch for oil spills, paint spills, and graffiti removal in Silicon Valley.

## Primary Service Areas (Silicon Valley & Peninsula)
- Santa Clara County: San Jose, Santa Clara, Sunnyvale, Cupertino, Mountain View, Palo Alto, Los Gatos, Saratoga, Campbell, Milpitas.
- San Mateo County: Menlo Park, Redwood City, San Carlos, San Mateo, Foster City, Burlingame.
